subtasks.description: Declare a constant 256-entry inverse S-box lookup table (ROM) with the complete standard AES inverse S-box values, where each entry is 8-bit wide and address corresponds to the input byte.
constraints: All 256 entries must exactly match the standard AES inverse S-box mapping values.

subtasks.description: Implement a purely combinational continuous assignment that drives output b with the table entry inv_sbox_table[a].
constraints: Must be purely combinational; no clock, reset, or sequential elements.
Output b must update combinatorially after any change on input a.
